scope: Vietnam U.S. 2015 income-tax agreement operative status

outcomes.summary: Recovered actual official BOT-hosted original Gazette Ministry Notifications 11 and 12 and Officer Notice 35 with official unofficial English translations. Both original 19 January Gazette instruments visually read. Ministry Notification 11 has a strict below-USD-10-million goods exception and conditional named larger-goods exemptions; No12 concerns gold. The Thai Officer Notice 35 signature date is 23 January, while its English translation says 15 January; no Officer Notice 35 Gazette commencement inferred. Exact PDF sources and provenance are in the proposal.
outcomes.technicalNote: Original Thai package is malformed for Poppler (3 pages) but PyMuPDF repairs its page tree to 7 pages and exposes the two original Ministry Notification 11 scan pages. Original bytes retained unchanged. This is a viewer/extraction issue, not a substituted or fabricated source.

outcomes.summary: Located full reproductions of Cục Thuế letter 5319/CT-CS dated 28 July 2026, and downloaded a publicly linked two-page TS24 typeset PDF. Read full Vietnamese text and visually examined page 1. It attributes a statement that the US–Vietnam income-tax agreement is not in force, in an answer to Hanoi tax authority concerning Company 5G’s 2023/2024 Google/YouTube advertising revenue. It includes withholding in that stated gross-revenue treatment and describes a documented foreign-CIT credit cap. This would be useful dated administrative-case context if an issuer original can be corroborated.
outcomes.sourceKind: Secondary publisher typeset reproduction of attributed government-letter text; not an issuer-hosted signed scan.
outcomes.provenance: PDF title Văn bản pháp luật - TS24corp; Author www.ts24.com.vn; Creator Writer / Producer LibreOffice 26.2.5.2; visible TS24 watermark. Two legal databases and an auditor newsletter carry matching text/date, but this corroboration is not falsely labelled issuer verification.
notVerified: Official issuer-original publication or signed copy was not recovered.
